description: This source file contains client-side JavaScript code responsible for UI interactions such as toggling password visibility, handling CTA button clicks, and managing filter chip toggling on a web page.

methods.name: qs(sel, root = document)
methods.description: Simplified querySelector helper function, optionally scoped to a root element.

methods.name: qsa(sel, root = document)
methods.description: Simplified querySelectorAll helper function returning an array, optionally scoped to a root element.

methods.name: setupPasswordToggle()
methods.description: Sets up click event listeners on elements with data-toggle='password' to toggle their associated input field between password and text types.

methods.name: setupCTAs()
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for call-to-action buttons, social provider buttons, and filter chip groups, including placeholder actions and filter collection.

ctags.name: qs
ctags.pattern: /^  function qs(sel, root = document) { return root.querySelector(sel); }$/

ctags.name: qsa
ctags.pattern: /^  function qsa(sel, root = document) { return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(sel)); }$/
